jobs.summary: The Business Operations Analyst turns operational and customer data into actionable insights to improve efficiency and support SLA compliance. The analyst delivers reliable reports and maintains data integrity to enable better decision making and continuous process improvement.

Individual dedication, team expertise, and passion involved in each interaction with clients and customers represent our commitment to reliable service delivery. We are looking for a Business Operations Analyst to join our team! If you are a communicative team player with great problem-solving skills, attention to detail, take a closer look at the position's main duties and responsibilities: Analyze data to uncover insights that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and increase profitability Gather and interpret internal and external data to understand business performance and identify improvement opportunities Prepare reports, dashboards, and scorecards for leadership to support day-to-day decision-making Ensure data integrity and provide solutions for any data-related issues Catalog existing analytics and reports with clear documentation on usage, updates, and methodology Use analytical techniques to optimize processes, save time, and drive continuous improvement Identify new opportunities for advanced analytics and determine the best methods to collect and use data Support Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance and analyze performance metrics Act as a subject matter expert for reporting deliverables and assist account teams as needed Resolve problems efficiently while keeping stakeholders informed and maintaining strong relationships Reference: Q9IUkQHud4tRo77sN_tRjDXfCzSKxNFkhTetCu1k5WGGtMoE-qtlE2boMaizz4Wn What we expect from you: 1-3 years of relevant experience Proficiency in German and English ; jobs.title: Biznis konsultant
jobs.details: Biznis konsultant Biznis konsultant Flaner d.o.o. 2.7 Beograd Beograd: Buleva Mihajla Pupina 115v 20.10.2026. ERP intermediate Mi smo Flaner – od 2014. godine pružamo različite vrste IT usluga sa posebnim fokusom na implementaciju, razvoj, konsalting i održavanje isplativih IT rešenja. U poslovanju koristimo sopstvenu ekspertizu, jaka partnerstva i strateške saveze sa vodećim dobavljačima tehnologija. Raspisujemo konkurs za poziciju Biznis konsultanta , poznavaoca svog posla. Opis posla Analiza poslovnih zahteva i njihovo prevođenje u IT rešenja Analiza i rešavanje problema i korisničkih zahteva Konfiguracija i unapređenje ERP-a Priprema funkcionalnih specifikacija i projektne dokumentacije Učešće u testiranju i puštanju rešenja u produkciju Saradnja sa korisnicima i članovima tima Podrška korisnicima i unapređenje postojećih rešenja Potrebno: Završene osnovne/master studije ekonomskog fakulteta 3-5 godina iskustva u finansijskim poslovima Odlično poznavanje ključnih procesa i razumevanje finansijskih i računovodstvenih procesa Dobre komunikacione veštine i orijentisanost ka korisniku Sposobnost samostalnog rada, ali i timske saradnje Nudimo: Rad na konkretnim i kompleksnim projektima velikih sistema Konkurentnu zaradu u skladu sa znanjem i iskustvom Mogućnost razvoja i usavršavanja Rad u profesionalnom okruženju, sa najboljima u regionu Prijatnu radnu i kolegijalnu atmosferu Dodatno dobrovoljno zdravstveno osiguranje Dodatne dane godišnjeg odmora Besplatan parking Konkuriši Upoznaj kompaniju O Kompaniji Iskustva Plate Mi smo Flaner – mlada kompanija koja posluje u Beogradu, od 2014. godine. Pružamo različite vrste IT usluga visokog kvaliteta, sa posebnim fokusom na implementaciju, razvoj, konsalting i održavanje isplativih IT rešenja. U poslovanju koristimo sosptvenu ekspertizu i strateške saveze sa vodećim dobavljačima tehnologija. Uz potpunu posvećenost svakom projektu i zajednički rad sa klijetnima pri svakom koraku projekta, pokretali smo digitalne transformacije, ubrzavali poslovne procese, ojačavali reputacije, unapređivali efikasnosti i kreirali konkurentne prednosti za njihova poslovanja. Primenjujući efikasne poslovne strategije i jaka partnerstva sa najeminentnijim IT kompanijama, znanje i iskustvo gradili smo kroz veoma uspešne projekte, stičući značajne kompetencije i ujedno gradeći stručni tim. Danas naš stručni tim odlično poznaje poslovne procese u različitim domenima poslovanja i poseduje veliko iskustvo na brojnim SAP projektima. Zato klijentima nudimo svoja rešenja, kao i rešenja zasnovana na svetski priznatim tehnologijama. Na tržištu smo poznati i cenjeni zahvaljujući implementaciji SAP rešenja, pa je i naš trenutni portfolio okrenut ka SAP proizvodima: SAP ISU, SAP ERP i SuccessFactors, kao i pomoć pri licenciranju i kupovini SAP licenci. Jednako uspešno se bavimo i procesima integracije SAP proizvoda sa ostalim non-SAP rešenjima, razvojem sopstvenih rešenja po SaaS modelu, izradom rešenja za određene delatnosti u skladu sa potrebama klijenata, kao i podrškom u IT segmentu u cilju smanjenja troškova. Izgradnja uspešnog tima za nas je mnogo više od pronalaženja grupe ljudi sa pravim miksom profesionalnih veština. Prihvatanjem velikih, kompleksnih projekata, i predanim i stručnim radom na njima, stvorili smo pozitivno radno okruženje u kojem negujemo zajedništvo, poštovanje i profesionalni razvoj. Pratimo potrebe svih članova tima, ulažemo u njihovo znanje i veštine kroz kontinuirane obuke, razmenu znanja i iskusta

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.summary: Senior Frontend and Mobile Developer will design and implement frontend interfaces and a native iOS application for a cloud backed eMobility platform. The role requires close collaboration with frontend backend mobile and UI UX specialists in an agile team to deliver maintainable and scalable user facing software.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Who are we KEBA Novi Sad is part of the Austrian KEBA Group, a technology company with more than 50 years of experience in industrial automation, energy management, banking automation, e-mobility and logistics. Location & work model This role is based in Novi Sad. We work in a hybrid setup with one guaranteed home office day per week, while additional remote days are possible depending on the project and team needs. Since we are building a new engineering capability from the ground up, we believe close day-to-day collaboration is essential. That's why this is primarily an on-site role. Help us build KEBA's Data Platform KEBA is building an enterprise data platform that will provide the foundation for data, analytics and AI across the entire Group. After developing our first data products, exploring different architectural approaches and building our Data Engineering capability, we are now entering the next phase: turning what we have built into a reliable, secure and scalable platform. For that, we are looking for a Data Platform Engineer (DataOps) . You will work alongside Data Engineers and experienced internal and external experts, taking ownership of the infrastructure, automation and operational foundations that allow our data platform to scale. We are building a platform for the next decade—not for the next sprint. That also shapes the way we work: we value automation, thoughtful engineering, sustainable pace and long-term thinking over constant firefighting. What will you actually do? Your focus will be on making our data platform reliable, repeatable and easy to operate. You will automate deployments, manage cloud infrastructure, establish observability and operational practices, and help Data Engineers deploy and operate their workloads safely and efficiently. This is not a role where you simply operate an established platform. You will help define how DataOps is done at KEBA. Responsibilities ► Operate and continuously improve our enterprise data platform ► Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and release processes using GitLab ► Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code across platform environments ► Establish monitoring, logging, alerting and operational support ► Improve platform reliability, performance, availability and infrastructure cost efficiency ► Support Data Engineers in deploying, operating and troubleshooting data workloads ► Help shape platform security, access management and compliance practices ► Take ownership of DataOps topics and contribute to the technical evolution of the platform Requirements ► Professional experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DataOps or a similar role ► Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and modern cloud infrastructure ► Strong understanding of Git, CI/CD and release management ► Experience with Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code tool ► Good understanding of cloud networking concepts ► Programming or scripting experience, preferably Python and/or SQL ► Experience with monitoring, logging and troubleshooting production systems ► Strong automation mindset, ownership and problem-solving skills ► Professional proficiency in English Nice to have ► Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks or similar data platforms ► Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles ► Knowledge of Azure networking technologies such as VNets, Private Endpoints and ExpressRoute ► Experience with Docker and containerized workloads ► Experience with security,

jobs.details: O poslodavcu KO SMO MI? NTS International je regionalna kompanija koja od 2006. godine razvija softverska rešenja za upravljanje transportom i logistikom. Sve faze — od analize i razvoja do implementacije i održavanja — realizujemo interno, u bliskoj saradnji sa korisnicima. Naša rešenja koristi više od 2.000 kompanija, a naš Fleet Management System povezuje više od 25.000 vozila. Uspeh gradimo na stručnosti tima, stalnom razvoju i primeni savremenih tehnologija, kao i na dugogodišnjem iskustvu i timskom radu. Zbog širenja poslovanja i razvoja tržišta, tražimo novog člana tima na poziciji: Junior konsultant za transport i Fleet Management rešenja KOGA TRAŽIMO? Tražimo motivisanu osobu koja želi da razvija karijeru u oblastima transporta, logistike i informacionih tehnologija. Pozicija je namenjena kandidatima na početku profesionalnog puta, koji su spremni da uče, sarađuju sa klijentima i postepeno preuzimaju samostalnije zadatke.
